privacy_APIs.API_name: Passing user's consent to Smart Display SDK
conditions: User must provide consent for using their personal data
Compliance with IAB specifications is recommended
effects: Retrieves consent signals and passes them to the ad request

conditions: CMP must be compliant with IAB specifications
effects: Smart Display SDK retrieves and uses the provided consent string

conditions: If using a non-IAB compliant CMP
effects: Manual setting of consent string required in SharedPreferences/NSUserDefaults

privacy_APIs.API_name: Passing CCPA consent string to Smart Display SDK
conditions: User must provide consent under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
The CCPA consent string must be stored correctly
effects: Consent string utilized to respect user's privacy rights under CCPA

conditions: User must consent to data collection under CCPA
effects: Smart Display SDK retrieves the CCPA consent string automatically

conditions: Using a CMP that does not respect IAB specifications
effects: Manual setting of CCPA consent string required in SharedPreferences/NSUserDefaults

conditions: User must have already provided location consent
Application must be compliant with GPP or local regulations
effects: User's location is automatically retrieved if consent is given
Location will be sent in ad calls
Location will not be sent in ad calls
